core/app-entry.ts // DIRECT_DOM_MOUNT 
// Strict CSP-compliant native instantiation
import { Flutcom } from './flutcom/core.js';
import { routes, partials } from './flutcom.config.js';

const app = new Flutcom({
  routes,
  partials,
  strictMode: true
});

app.init(); // Direct DOM mount (0 ms hydration)
